in_marathi.name: Joga
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे To Yoke, To Unite
in_marathi.long_meaning: Joga हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Joga signifies the union of the individual self with the supreme consciousness. It represents the process of connecting the inner self to the divine, and finding inner peace and harmony.
